summary: EVAVO's Windows-first native-ComfyUI image-generation control plane and agent transport layer. It owns backend discovery/provisioning/health, bounded startup diagnostics, evidence-gated dependency repair, model inventory, workflow preflight, real prompt submission, normalized jobs/history/queue status, targeted per-generation cancellation, output collection/inspection, bounded batches, shared task history, MCP delivery and secure ChatGPT tunnelling. Claude and ChatGPT use the same MCP implementation through different transports. MCP file access is owner-confined and generated images require ordinary-file identity plus valid image signatures. Its optional hardened loopback gateway may delegate video/audio/3D work to separately governed sibling Studio providers without making those modalities owned MCP/package capabilities. The deterministic mock is test infrastructure only.

capabilities.title: Discover, diagnose and health-check native ComfyUI
capabilities.description: Discover source/portable/external ComfyUI instances, probe live native endpoints, run bounded startup diagnostics, inspect the last structured startup failure and reuse healthy user-managed renderers without replacing or killing them.
requires: Local/loopback ComfyUI endpoint for live readiness

capabilities.title: Repair proven core ComfyUI dependency drift safely
capabilities.description: Use structured missing-dependency startup evidence to synchronize the discovered ComfyUI checkout's own requirements.txt into its selected interpreter. MCP callers cannot choose arbitrary packages, Python executables or ComfyUI paths; custom-node dependency failures are refused by the core repair path; shell execution and broad process cleanup are not used; every repair returns a structured receipt.
requires: Structured missing_dependency evidence for normal mutation
Network only when pip must obtain missing requirements

capabilities.title: Provision an official native ComfyUI runtime when needed
capabilities.description: Reuse reviewed existing source/portable installs before optionally cloning/provisioning official ComfyUI, isolate source runtimes, validate Torch/CUDA/entrypoint readiness and never silently choose a diffusion model.

capabilities.title: Inventory local ComfyUI model resources
capabilities.description: Discover checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs, ControlNets, UNETs, text encoders, CLIP vision and upscalers including shared external model libraries without copying multi-gigabyte files.

capabilities.title: Preflight custom ComfyUI workflows without rendering
capabilities.description: Render generation substitutions and validate live node classes, required inputs and literal model choices without queueing work. MCP workflow files are owner-confined and tool-supplied paths are disabled by default.

capabilities.title: Generate images through real native ComfyUI
capabilities.description: Submit standard or preflighted custom workflows, retain real prompt IDs, wait when requested and collect verified image outputs atomically. MCP output paths remain under owner-approved roots and invalid file/wait policy is rejected before backend work.

capabilities.title: Track and safely cancel individual ComfyUI generations
capabilities.description: Normalize current ComfyUI jobs plus legacy history/queue into queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled or unknown. Target cancellation uses the current per-job cancel API; older servers may dequeue one proven-pending prompt but EVAVO refuses broad /interrupt for a running legacy job.
requires: Healthy native ComfyUI for live job operations

capabilities.title: Collect and expose generated outputs for inspection
capabilities.description: Collect outputs through native /view, validate image bytes before promotion, atomically download authorized files and return generated images as MCP image content. Symlinks/redirected paths and extension-only fake images are rejected.

capabilities.title: Maintain shared generation task history and statistics
capabilities.description: Maintain lock-protected atomic task history shared by CLI and MCP and expose bounded status/statistics, including failed and cancelled reconciliation.

capabilities.title: Expose local image-generation MCP services
capabilities.description: Serve one shared MCP v2 implementation over stdio and private loopback Streamable HTTP. Claude Desktop uses stdio; ChatGPT reaches the same private server through the authorised secure tunnel. Persistent profiles carry only non-secret owner path policy.

capabilities.title: Bridge private workstation MCP to ChatGPT securely
capabilities.description: Configure the outbound OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel using an existing tunnel identity/runtime key, verify tunnel-client integrity and protect persistent runtime keys with current-user Windows DPAPI instead of exposing localhost publicly.

capabilities.title: Expose a hardened private loopback compatibility gateway
capabilities.description: Expose REST/WebSocket compatibility only on loopback with CORS disabled by default, bounded request bodies, owner-confined workflow paths, ordinary-file result identity, atomic task persistence, corrupt-state fail-closed behavior and one live gateway owner per task-state file.
requires: Native ComfyUI for healthy owned image generation

capabilities.title: Delegate optional gateway media to governed sibling Studio providers
capabilities.description: Keep image ownership here while allowing the loopback gateway to delegate video, audio and 3D only to readiness-checked sibling providers. Provider work is fail-closed, receipt-backed, timeout-bounded, output-confined and digest-verified when supplied.
requires: Ready reviewed provider for the requested delegated modality

capabilities.title: Run repository and Windows integration verification
capabilities.description: Run read-only structural verification plus all discovered root, provider and package safety/integration suites, optionally requiring PowerShell AST validation, and distinguish simulator contract tests from real native-backend readiness.
requires: Native ComfyUI only for live generation readiness
